notes.title: Splashscreen Update 2024
notes.content:
I'm glad to present to you first proper ReTox update! It was a long time from last uploaded version (07.11.21!) but that doesn't mean that the works on the game slowed down, it just wasn't so visible, Now also the game informs that there's no soundtrack (Check out our youtube channel to listen to the ReTox OST, at this point there's 13 tracks) or sounds due to many people asking if something is broken. This decision was made because it would be just inconsistent to have 3 songs in the game in some random moments and leave the rest of the game silent. I'd personally get heart attack if suddenly a hardstyle track started playing in a club without warning, so It's not implemented for now.

Fix list:
-Polish version revised text
-English version revised text and fixed few places where the text wasn't translating or was repeating itself
-Fixed game breaking bug in english version: while talking to Dr Holgin, after the test, the game crashed. It's fixed.
-In opioids storyline when checking the basket in store the game was crashing because of the wrong type of variable put in the string, it's fixed.
-Achievements Are Am Eye and Mommy told you weren't working. They're fixed now.
-Getting Salvia or DMT too early in the game if doing certain plot got fixed.
-Not getting discoball if getting the alternative ending in the club plot got fixed (in hub and in methcathinone).
-Getting the mandala poster after getting the bad ending in psychedelics plot got fixed.
-Problem with methcathinone filter if you stay at home got fixed (it didn't show up if you move somewhere).
-When the protagonist was speaking the title "You" didn't show up in English translation, it was fixed.

Added stuff:
+Assets of 3 new characters were added: Hobo, security guy and a bouncer at crack
+Talking animation for Trapezoid and Kriss added
+5 new backgrounds added (Backgrounds of Crack and Blasphemous Transylvania gig). Which also means that all backgrounds were added to the game.
+Animation to indicate that you died
+Splashscreen with a choice of a language
